overview_description.description: Avare BioTech is a Dubai-based biotechnology and animal health startup specializing in AI-powered reproductive diagnostics for the livestock industry. The company develops innovative mobile semen analysis technologies, including its proprietary MAKSA (Mobile-Assisted Key Semen Analysis) platform, which transforms smartphones and microscopes into portable laboratory-grade diagnostic tools. By leveraging artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cloud-based analytics, Avare BioTech enables veterinarians, breeders, artificial insemination centers, and livestock producers to perform accurate semen quality assessments without relying on expensive traditional CASA laboratory equipment.
